???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "Why does a back end built purely from macro expansion need no register allocator?"

        Every value lives in its own stack slot and no value stays in a register past its own template, so no two values ever compete for a register and nothing needs saving around a call except the return address.

        Introduced in [B. A first native back end: B1. The simplest back end that works](b1-simplest-backend.md).

    ??? question "What do we call the form of the program inside the compiler that is no longer source text but not yet machine code?"

        The intermediate representation (IR). It sits between the front end and the back end.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "Which half of the compiler reads the source, works out what it means and rejects bad programs?"

        The front end. In this guide it is stages 1 to 5.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).
